rules.rule: Check for urgent skin ulcer or non-healing wound conditions
rules.problem: It covers every red-box item. Vitals are routine, so they're correctly left out. The infection items share the cellulitis imprecision.

rules.rule: Check for the cause of a skin ulcer or non-healing wound
rules.problem: The pressure-ulcer sites match the dots on the body figure: occiput, upper spine, scapulae, elbows, sacrum, the lateral iliac/hip dots, ankles and heels. 'Hyperpigmentation of skin' has no site. Nothing encodes the genital-ulcer redirect (->62) or the cause-uncertain branch, but neither says 'likely'.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable critical limb ischaemia in a patient with a skin ulcer or non-healing wound
rules.problem: The page says 'critical limb ischaemia likely', so probable is right. The rule reads it as claudication AND (rest pain OR gangrene). '(claudication AND rest pain) OR gangrene' is another possible reading, so a patient with gangrene but no claudication history would not be caught.

The 'not a pressure ulcer' gate (NOT bedridden/wheelchair OR NOT at any of the 8 sites) and the leg/pulse logic are faithful. But the lower-leg-or-foot gate only accepts the 'lower limb from knee to ankle' and 'Foot structure' sites. An ulcer recorded at the ankle region (or at the heel, unless site descendants match) in an ambulatory patient won't reach the arterial, venous or diabetic branch, though it is on the 'lower leg or foot' by the page. Each branch also needs explicit 'no' records for every pressure site or for both mobility items.
The flow is right (No arterial features, then venous features). It has the same ankle/heel site gap as the arterial rule, and the hyperpigmentation has no site.
The flow is right (No arterial, No venous, then known diabetes). It has the same ankle/heel site gap as the arterial rule. 'Skin ulcer due to diabetes mellitus' is a reasonable target.

rules.rule: Urgent: skin ulcer or non-healing wound with infection and systemic or severe signs
rules.problem: The structure is faithful: complaint AND infection AND any-of. All thresholds and directions match the page (SBP < 80, pulse > 100, temp >= 38). Urgent matches the box heading. The infection concepts lack cellulitis.

rules.rule: Urgent: skin ulcer or non-healing wound with critical limb ischaemia

summary: The most consequential gap: the arterial, venous and diabetic rules gate on an ulcer site of only 'lower limb from knee to ankle' or 'Foot structure'. An ambulatory patient's ankle (and possibly heel) ulcer, which the page counts as lower leg/foot, may never reach any of the three diagnoses. The red-box infection is encoded as infected ulcer/local wound infection, without the cellulitis (red/warm/swollen surrounding skin) the page defines it by, and 'darkening of skin around ulcer' has no finding site. Otherwise the rules follow the page: thresholds, flowchart order, the probable levels on every 'likely', and the pressure sites read from the body figure.
